articles.title: Brasile, la deputata transgender Erika Hilton è la donna più votata della storia alla Camera
articles.summary: La politica, 33 anni, del Partito socialismo e libertà (Psol) di San Paolo è stata rieletta a San Paolo con 1.596.472 voti. Nella graduatoria complessiva dei candidati, Hilton si è piazzata al secondo posto a livello nazionale

articles.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
articles.summary: Nvidia-backed Reflection AI unveils Beam, its first open-weight model, which it says rivals GLM-5.2 on reasoning with far less inference compute. Weights are due this month.

articles.title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
articles.summary: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.
